title: imagebuildah: persist WORKDIR directories
body:
## Summary

`WORKDIR` creates its directory while processing the instruction, but Buildah does not treat it as a layer-producing step. If no later `RUN`, `COPY`, or `ADD` modifies the filesystem, the final commit is marked empty and drops the directory. A later `USER` then causes the runtime to create the missing working directory with the wrong owner.

Treat `WORKDIR` as a layer-producing step so its directory is saved in the image. Add a regression test that inspects the root filesystem before the container starts.

Fixes #7177.

## Testing

- `go test ./imagebuildah`
- Built Buildah on Fedora aarch64.
- Checked the OCI output for both default and `--layers` builds; `/workspace` is present and owned by `0:0` before container start.
- `git diff --check`
- The BATS test was not run locally because `bats` is not installed; CI will run it.
